d.d: To endure or tolerate (something); to experience.
Very; incredibly; profoundly; to an extreme degree; dreadfully.
Hell; the bottomless pit; primeval chaos; a confined subterranean ocean.
A bottomless or unfathomed depth, gulf, or chasm; hence, any deep, immeasurable; any void space.
Of or belonging to the ocean depths, especially below 2000 metres (6500 ft): abyssal zone.
Pertaining to or occurring at excessive depths in the earth's crust; plutonic.
In the utter depths of despair; gloomy.
Former name of Ethiopia: a country and former empire in East Africa; used as an exonym until the mid 20th century.
Of or pertaining to the Abyssinian Church.
A short-haired domestic cat descended from the cats of ancient Egypt, making it one of the oldest breeds in the world.
A member of the Abyssinian Church.
